content:
**SDD reader rendering is bounded off the main thread (#1218)**

What: expanding an SDD document no longer runs marked on the main thread. A pure pre-scan (lib/markdown.mjs) degrades any inline span with more than 600 of * _ ~ [ ] or a single run over 50 to announced plain text; a module worker (lib/markdown-worker.mjs, one per request) does the lexing, and lib/render-budget.mjs terminates it at 1500 ms and shows the document as plain text with a notice. A missing change branch reads as missing (no change branch in this clone); one git runner (ui/git-run.mjs) pipes stderr so an unreadable reason names git's cause. Why: round-2 cold review of #1212 measured an 11 s freeze on 200 KB of unbalanced emphasis. Learned: marked's inline tokenizer is quadratic per inline span (emStrong recursion, link-regex backtracking), not the block phase; real artifacts peak at 59 delimiter marks per span; worker startup is about 40-57 ms; three copies of the default git run existed (server, change-route, watcher); a real 1500 ms setTimeout left pending after dom.restore() exits the test process 1 with every subtest ok; test/publish-allowlist.e2e.test.mjs is line-keyed by test-spawn-hygiene so edits must be net-zero in lines.
